about: A recorded run of From a shoebox to a website on the fictional sample shoebox (samples/), made with tools/record-merge.mjs from the same request bodies as the page. Model output, as it came.

events.markdown:
# FORNO DA RIBEIRA

Family bakery in Porto since 1962

## **Baked in our wood oven every morning**

Broa de milho, our corn bread
Sourdough loaves and rye
Custard tarts, warm from 8 am
Almond cakes on Saturdays

## **Opening hours**

Tuesday to Sunday, 7 am to 7 pm
Closed on Mondays

## **Find us**

Rua da Fonte 12, 4050 Porto
Phone +351 220 000 000
ola@forno-da-ribeira.example

A fictional sample for a demo. Not a real business.

events.transcript: Hello, this is a note for the new website. We are Forno da Ribeira, a family bakery in Porto. My grandmother opened it in 1962. We still bake everything in the wood oven, starting at 5:00 every morning. People come for the broa de milho, our corn bread, and for the custard tarts, which are warm from 8:00. We are open Tuesday to Sunday, from 7:00 in the morning to 7:00 in the evening.
